meaning.en: The act by which something is ferried.

sentences.en: Ferrying labor into space is technologically feasible, of course, but prohibitively expensive.

sentences.en: Yet they exist, ferrying passengers around the globe year-round.

sentences.en: The airplanes are ferrying motorcars between England and France.
